title: Patrick P NDE 9430
content: I had taken some Delta-8 gummies with my sister since they were legal and I wanted to relax. I can't drink due to Asian Flush syndrome and wanted to celebrate my recent graduation for my Master's degree in Space Studies - Aerospace Science. Both my sister and I took the same dose (3 gummies) then I headed to bed with my wife. My sister was fine with No ill effects. About two hours later I woke up in worst pain than anything I could imagine. I managed to gain a tiny bit of control over my muscles to tell my wife to call 911 before I started "fading". I could feel my heart seizing and my vision starting looking like I was dropping away. I was screaming in my head to get out of it. The lights in the room were on and I didn't even notice the lights were on at that point as it all went dark. In the shades of a color I cannot describe, like a brown-purple-grey-black, I saw a rope and ballard line like the line to a club with rope gates leading to the front of a building. The "bouncer" quickly clasped the rope closed and some of my deceased family members were there telling me "No, go back!" In the void a soothing voice told me "No, not like this. Follow my breathing. Concentrate on breathing." It was coaching me on breathing as I could feel my heart seize up again shooting pain down my limbs, which I had lost control of all conscience control over and they were just twitching. After the paramedics stabilized me, I was loaded in the ambulance. On the way to the hospital my vision turned red and had lines like looking at a voice on a spectrograph from a spectrum analyzer. As that happened I heart my heart monitor flat line and thought "aw f#$%. No, you gotta be kidding me!" Just then the voice cane back and coached me through breathing again. After that, I started to feel my limbs again. I feel like I've been given a second chance and that I'm confident God exists. God was coaching me on how to survive. If it wasn't God then who was it? I wasn't a voice you hear, you felt it. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 28 July 2022 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Allergic Reaction. Drug or medication overdose Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) poisonous substance, waiting for toxicology report. I was lucid the entire time and remembered thinking "aw f#$% No" when my heart monitor flatline briefly. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness I was in pain so definitely paying attention more. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Almost all of the time except when I was sedated at the hospital and finally got sleep. I was watching myself die. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It disappeared at times even though I knew my eyes were open. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear everything going on around me. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Hard to describe the color. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was barred from continuing forward into it at the gate. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Focused, like "how do I come back". Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others A lot aware, like I had a purpose to be sent back. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of No return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will The "bouncer" and dead relatives were telling me to go back. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated. Logical skepticism based on a lack of evidence. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I know God hears me when I praise it. What is your religion now? Other or several faiths. God exists but not as human as we describe in religions. God is God. At the center of the universe, you can hear its heart beat and that is the origin of all life. I dare anyone to dispute this and create complex life in a lab. At the center of the milky way, you can hear the heartbeat. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I was a "0's and 1's" type of guy who didn't believe anything without evidence. I have seen the evidence and I believe now. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I believe in a God now. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify A voice you didn't hear but felt. It wasn't familiar. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes I was sent back for a reason. I don't know why. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes The heartbeat of God can be heard at the center of every constellation. We are connected to it. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes The being was coaching me back. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I was told I was going back for a reason. I was never told why. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes Whatever it was, I was barred from entering. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. I appreciate everything more. It's like my life has "come into focus". Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I am much more grateful for everyone. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Some things like the color are hard to describe. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes My sister, my brother-in-law, my mother, and my wife. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real No doubt anymore. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No
